messages:
Avery (CEO): Quick update — keeping this short. Two big asks this week: 1) finish rollout guardrail for Private beta (SLA + data retention), 2) finalize cost playbook for Dedicated pools. More below. :eyes:

Priya (VP Product): Thanks. Private beta: Legal signed off on changing analytics log retention to 90 days; audit logs will be retained separately. I uploaded the policy diff: https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/Policy-123 (see section 2.1). Can engineering confirm the migration window?

Marco (Head Eng): We'll run a rolling migration Wed night (11pm PT) and do a smoke test Thu morning. ETA ~6h for the migration job. Ops will post the runbook in #eng-oncall. cc @ops-bot

ops-bot: Scheduled migration job created: `migration/private-beta-logs-v2` -> starts 2024-10-02T06:00Z. Monitor: https://infra.redwood/status/1234

Sofia (Head Sales): Heads up — this change shouldn't affect customer traffic. I'll prepare an AE-facing script and tag the two flagged enterprise accounts for proactive outreach.

Avery (CEO): Quick metric snapshot: hosted generation p50 latency = 42ms last week (good). Unit token cost down 7% q/q after batching tweaks. We did see an error-rate spike Tue due to a GPU driver rollout. Marco, what's the mitigation?

Marco (Head Eng): Root cause: a driver update rolled onto ~10% of nodes without the new preflight check. Mitigation: pinned the driver, rolled back bad bundle, added a preflight to the rollout job. New alert rule: `gpu.driver.failures > 0 for 5m` -> page on-call. Draft postmortem in #postmortems; will link here when ready.

Priya (VP Product): For the Dedicated cost playbook: target is a short public-facing doc + two internal examples (low-latency chat, high-throughput embeddings) mapping to config presets. Goal: publish by Friday EOD.

Avery (CEO): Two asks for leads: (a) confirm migration timeline + runbook by EOD today; (b) share playbook examples by Thu noon so finance can model savings assumptions. If either slips, call it out early. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Marco (Head Eng): Ack. I'll post the runbook link here once created. Will include rollback commands, e.g. `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-runtime` and monitoring dashboard IDs.

Sofia (Head Sales): Noted. AE comms template will be in the sales folder by Thu. I'll tag AE leads for the two accounts.

Avery (CEO): Thanks team — skipping the longer sync this week unless there are blockers. If anything critical, ping me directly. Short deck: https://drive.redwood/lead-update-q3 (2 slides). :rocket:
